n636e2eaa1f.headline: EU and Moldova agree energy security plan to wean country off Russian supplies
n636e2eaa1f.summary: The EU and Moldova have agreed an energy security plan to wean the country off Russian supplies. Hundreds of thousands of people were left without heating and hot water after Gazprom cut off supplies.
n636e2eaa1f.why: Moldova depends heavily on Russian gas, and Gazprom is Russia's state gas exporter, so supply disruptions hit households and power generation.

n651ba60642.headline: EVH completes takeover of Salamis Tours — acquires 91.18 per cent stake
n651ba60642.summary: EVH Investments completed the mandatory public takeover offer for Salamis Tours on January 31. The offer secured a 91.18 per cent stake, against an aim to acquire up to 100 per cent of issued share capital.
n651ba60642.why: Mandatory takeover offers allow acquirers to gain control of a listed company, and minority holders' treatment depends on the final stake.

n133759b6fe.headline: Japan's Sumitomo raises annual profit forecast despite Ambatovy loss
n133759b6fe.summary: Sumitomo Corp raised its net profit forecast by 6% for the year through March. Stronger overseas power generation earnings and higher aluminium prices offset a loss at Ambatovy.
n133759b6fe.why: Sumitomo is a large Japanese trading house with diversified holdings in power, metals and resources.

n7c5cb486d5.headline: Key summit draws $50bn in commitments to electrify Africa
n7c5cb486d5.summary: The Mission 300 summit in Dar es Salaam aimed to build momentum toward extending electricity to 300 million Africans. Commitments totalling $50bn were drawn at the event.
n7c5cb486d5.why: Electrification investment supports power utilities, energy infrastructure developers and construction across African economies.

n57a679e0a5.headline: Ukraine’s mineral riches have long been eyed by its allies. Now they may be Trump’s price for military aid
n57a679e0a5.summary: US President Donald Trump said he wants access to Ukraine's mineral deposits in exchange for future military aid that Kyiv needs against Russia. The comment highlights a transactional approach to the war.
n57a679e0a5.why: Ukraine holds significant deposits of critical minerals, and access terms would shape resource investment and the wider geopolitical settlement.

n436cabdf07.headline: IT BT Budget Round Table 2025: India’s fundamentals remain strong, says FM Sitharaman - BusinessToday
n436cabdf07.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said India's fundamentals remain strong and declined to speculate on US tariff action. She said the Budget 2025 income tax relief aims to maintain taxpayer trust.
n436cabdf07.why: India's fiscal and tax policy shapes growth, consumption and returns for investors in Indian equities and bonds.

nd0c2c45a71.headline: Smirnoff Maker Diageo Scraps Midterm Guidance Amid Tariff Uncertainty -- Update
nd0c2c45a71.summary: Diageo, the maker of Johnnie Walker and Smirnoff, scrapped its midterm outlook due to uncertainty in key markets and warned that US trade tariffs could derail its recovery.
nd0c2c45a71.why: Diageo is one of the world's largest spirits companies, and its guidance is closely watched as a read on premium alcohol demand and trade conditions.

impacts.name: Diageo
impacts.why: Withdrawing midterm guidance removes a profit outlook and signals risk to its recovery.

nd0c2c45a71.why_moved: Diageo cited uncertainty in key markets and warned that US trade tariffs could derail its recovery, prompting it to scrap its midterm outlook.

n90748a8d8e.headline: Union Budget will boost growth over next few years via domestic demand through tax cuts for households: S&P Global
n90748a8d8e.summary: S&P Global said the fiscal 2026 budget will boost growth over the next few years through domestic demand, supported by tax cuts for households.
n90748a8d8e.why: India's budget and fiscal policy shape growth, inflation and bond supply, which matter for investors in Indian equities and rupee assets.

n1519c0ae91.headline: Rubio Celebrates that Panama will not Renew the Silk Road Pact with China
n1519c0ae91.summary: Panama's President José Raúl Mulino announced after a meeting that the Memorandum of Understanding on the Silk Road initiative with China would not be renewed. Panama's stance is a shift in its China economic ties.
n1519c0ae91.why: The Belt and Road (Silk Road) initiative covers Chinese infrastructure investment abroad, and Panama's canal and ports make its China relations relevant to trade flows.

n19e517425c.headline: Cyprus apartment prices and rents rise from year before
n19e517425c.summary: Apartment prices in Cyprus rose 1.3 per cent and rents rose 1.5 per cent year on year in the fourth quarter of 2024, according to Ask Wire.
n19e517425c.why: Residential property prices and rents are key indicators of household wealth, construction activity and bank mortgage exposure.

ndbd15a6776.headline: L&T shares: Capex bellwether tops Sensex gainers after Budget day fall. Here's why - BusinessToday
ndbd15a6776.summary: L&T shares closed at Rs 3,443.60 on the BSE, up 4.76%, leading Sensex gainers after a fall on Budget day. A BNP Paribas analyst set a target price of Rs 4,605.
ndbd15a6776.why: Larsen & Toubro is one of India's largest engineering and construction firms, and its results are a bellwether for infrastructure and capital spending. It is a constituent of the Sensex.

n9b9f71b207.headline: Sale of Belarus operations cuts Raiffeisen Bank International's profit by half
n9b9f71b207.summary: Raiffeisen Bank International posted a 2024 consolidated profit of 1.16 billion euros, 50% below the prior year's 2.39 billion. The company attributed the drop to the sale of its Belarus operations.
n9b9f71b207.why: Raiffeisen is a major Austrian lender with large operations in Central and Eastern Europe, so its earnings signal regional banking conditions.

impacts.why: Reported 2024 profit fell by half, with the Belarus sale cited as the cause.

n16dac8c192.headline: Digital dilemma
n16dac8c192.summary: Telecom tariff hikes may stifle online businesses and remote workers in Nigeria, where many small businesses sell online and rely on the internet for their livelihoods.
n16dac8c192.why: Telecom pricing affects digital commerce and the cost base of online businesses, and tariff policy is set by regulators and operators.

ne25436c4b6.headline: New Zealand unemployment rate climbs to 5.1 per cent
ne25436c4b6.summary: New Zealand's unemployment rate climbed to 5.1%. The opposition blamed the government of Christopher Luxon for job losses.
ne25436c4b6.why: The unemployment rate is a key labour-market indicator that influences the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's interest rate decisions.

ncde58ddcfa.headline: Africa needs to collaborate to achieve absolute transformation – MTN Ghana CFO
ncde58ddcfa.summary: MTN Ghana Chief Finance Officer Antoinette Kwofie called for harmonised regulations across Africa to attract capital for infrastructure investment on the continent.
ncde58ddcfa.why: MTN Group is a large pan-African telecom operator, and regulatory fragmentation across African markets affects the cost and availability of investment capital.

n4c1916b7a5.headline: Millions of workers set for £1,400 pay boost from April
n4c1916b7a5.summary: More than 3 million workers in shops, restaurants and workplaces across the UK will receive a £1,400 pay boost from April. The report did not detail the mechanism.
n4c1916b7a5.why: Pay rises for millions of low-to-middle earners affect UK retail and hospitality labour costs, consumer spending and wage-inflation dynamics tracked by the Bank of England.

n06a7016501.headline: Trade war: Nigeria braces for impact as U.S. tariffs signal fresh inflation concern
n06a7016501.summary: Nigeria and other African markets may face a new scramble as a tariff war between the United States and other economies develops. The article flags fresh inflation concerns from the US tariffs.
n06a7016501.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest economy by population, and trade tariffs affect its exports, import prices and inflation.

n3a9ac81a36.headline: Trump orders creation of US sovereign wealth fund that could buy part of TikTok
n3a9ac81a36.summary: Trump ordered the creation of a US sovereign wealth fund that could buy part of TikTok. He said many other nations have such funds and predicted the US fund could eventually top Saudi Arabia's in size.
n3a9ac81a36.why: Sovereign wealth funds are state-owned investment vehicles that can take large stakes in companies and assets, influencing capital flows and valuations.

n5c2bea61ed.headline: Lebanon President says he hopes TotalEnergies will resume oil and gas exploration soon
n5c2bea61ed.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun told Qatar's prime minister he hopes TotalEnergies will soon resume oil and gas exploration off Lebanon's coast. The input gives no timeline or reasons for the pause.
n5c2bea61ed.why: TotalEnergies is a French energy major, and its offshore exploration decisions affect Eastern Mediterranean gas supply prospects for Lebanon.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies
impacts.why: Resumption of offshore exploration would affect the company's Lebanese upstream activity.

ncc3c10f380.headline: CBN extends $25,000 weekly forex sales to BDCs
ncc3c10f380.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has extended temporary access for bureau de change operators to buy foreign exchange from the central bank. The weekly limit is $25,000, according to the report.
ncc3c10f380.why: Bureau de change access to official FX shapes naira liquidity and the gap between official and parallel exchange rates, a key concern for investors in Nigeria.

n10e69c529a.headline: China counters with tariffs on US products, announces Google investigation
n10e69c529a.summary: China announced tariffs on US products in response to a 10% US tariff on Chinese goods, and also announced an investigation into Google. Trump planned talks with the Chinese president in the coming days.
n10e69c529a.why: Tariff exchanges between the world's two largest economies affect global supply chains, trade flows, and corporate earnings. Google parent Alphabet is a major US technology company.
n10e69c529a.why_moved: New Chinese tariffs on US goods and a probe into Google raise trade-war concerns. The announcement came just before a planned tariff increase, adding uncertainty.

n6d4d61fdb1.headline: Trump agrees to pause tariffs on Canada and Mexico after they pledge to boost border enforcement
n6d4d61fdb1.summary: Trump agreed to pause tariffs on Canada and Mexico after both countries pledged to boost border enforcement. The pauses followed a few days that brought North America close to a trade war.
n6d4d61fdb1.why: Canada and Mexico are the United States' largest trading partners, so tariffs on them affect cross-border supply chains, currencies, and growth expectations across North America.
n6d4d61fdb1.why_moved: A pause on tariffs eases fears of a North American trade war that threatened economic growth. Markets were watching for escalation before the pause.

nd08faebf90.headline: Gov Oyebanji’s romance with Ekiti public service
nd08faebf90.summary: Ekiti State Governor Biodun Oyebanji approved a new minimum wage of N70,000 on November 19, 2024. The decision applies to the state's public service.
nd08faebf90.why: Minimum wage decisions by Nigerian states affect public-sector payroll costs and local labour market conditions.

n45b42664a7.headline: Trump's trade war with neighbours is delayed - what did they all get out of it?
n45b42664a7.summary: Trump paused tariffs for 30 days after receiving border promises from Canada and Mexico. BBC reporters assess the fallout in the US, Canada and Mexico.
n45b42664a7.why: Canada and Mexico are the largest trading partners of the US, so tariff changes affect cross-border trade flows and their currencies. Investors track these trade decisions closely.

n324c2dd365.headline: IT BT Budget Round Table 2025: India concerned about deceleration in global growth, but has to be prepared, says Finance Secretary - BusinessToday
n324c2dd365.summary: India's finance secretary said the country is concerned about a deceleration in global growth but must be prepared. He said the budget is non-inflationary and aims to revive private-sector animal spirits.
n324c2dd365.why: The finance secretary oversees India's budget and fiscal policy. Global growth conditions affect Indian exports, capital flows and corporate investment.

n0b6dd06e23.headline: SRMG Think hosts high-level discussion on IMF’s latest GCC economic report in Riyadh
n0b6dd06e23.summary: SRMG Think hosted a high-level discussion in Riyadh on the IMF's latest report on the Gulf Cooperation Council economies. The event focused on the report's findings.
n0b6dd06e23.why: The IMF publishes regional economic outlooks that inform investor views on Gulf economies. GCC economies are major oil producers whose budgets depend on energy revenues.

n0a91bebb67.headline: Stock markets stagger as US tariffs decisions come and go
n0a91bebb67.summary: US President Donald Trump's tariffs on Mexico, Canada and China rattled global markets, triggering sharp losses on Wall Street. Temporary reprieves for Mexico and Canada eased concerns, but China is set to be sanctioned.
n0a91bebb67.why: US tariffs on major trading partners affect global supply chains, corporate earnings and trade flows, so they are closely watched by investors worldwide.
n0a91bebb67.why_moved: Tariffs on Mexico, Canada and China rattled global markets and triggered sharp losses on Wall Street. Temporary reprieves for Mexico and Canada eased concerns, while China faced planned sanctions.

nf0eed600c9.headline: IT BT Budget Round Table 2025: GST cut will benefit everyone, put money in every pocket: P Chidambaram - BusinessToday
nf0eed600c9.summary: Former finance minister P Chidambaram welcomed the GST cut, but said masses deserve more money in their hands. He said GST or petrol and diesel taxes should have been reduced.
nf0eed600c9.why: Goods and services tax changes affect consumer prices and household spending, which drive a large part of India's economy.

nd5499bbaf6.headline: DWP fraud powers could let government access your bank account
nd5499bbaf6.summary: The Work and Pensions Secretary told Parliament that people entitled to claim benefits have nothing to worry about. The fraud powers could allow government access to bank accounts.
nd5499bbaf6.why: Rules on government access to bank data affect banks' compliance obligations and consumer financial privacy.

n2813d7360d.headline: North Yorkshire businesses call for cut in interest rates
n2813d7360d.summary: A group of leading Yorkshire businesspeople has called on the Bank of England to lower interest rates.
n2813d7360d.why: The Bank of England sets the UK's benchmark rate, which influences borrowing costs, sterling and business investment.

ncf787acc0e.headline: China retaliates with tariffs against US
ncf787acc0e.summary: China said it is retaliating against the United States with tariffs on specific US imports, following a decision that the Washington Examiner article links to earlier US measures.
ncf787acc0e.why: Tariff exchanges between the world's two largest economies affect global trade flows, supply chains and the earnings outlook of exporters.
ncf787acc0e.why_moved: China's announced tariffs on specific US imports escalate the trade dispute, raising expectations of higher costs for affected goods.

n6e85e71259.headline: US tariffs deadline lifts ringgit at close
n6e85e71259.summary: The ringgit settled higher against the US dollar on Tuesday after the US rolled back its tariff deadline on Mexico and Canada. An analyst said this lifted global growth sentiment.
n6e85e71259.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency and is sensitive to global trade sentiment and regional risk appetite. Malaysia's economy relies heavily on exports and commodities.
n6e85e71259.why_moved: An analyst linked the move to the rollback of the tariff deadline on Mexico and Canada, which lifted global growth sentiment.

nbcd1fe386a.headline: All-day row in Canberra over coalition's "long lunch" policy
nbcd1fe386a.summary: Labor says the coalition's long lunch tax break for businesses would cost taxpayers over A$1 billion a year, and accuses the Treasurer of politicising the public service.
nbcd1fe386a.why: Tax policy changes affect business spending, government revenue and the fiscal outlook that investors watch in Australia.

nb89ae1acdc.headline: Rio Tinto faces new iron ore shipping snarls due to cyclones
nb89ae1acdc.summary: Rio Tinto has begun clearing iron ore ships from two Western Australian ports, but two tropical cyclones offshore are swelling seas and complicating its repair efforts.
nb89ae1acdc.why: Rio Tinto is one of the world's largest iron ore producers, and shipping disruptions in Western Australia affect global steel-input supply.

impacts.name: Rio Tinto
impacts.why: Cyclone-related shipping snarls disrupt the company's iron ore exports from Western Australian ports.

n446f784a0b.headline: Trump to pause tariffs on Mexico and Canada after border enforcement pledges
n446f784a0b.summary: US President Donald Trump will pause tariffs on Mexico and Canada after border enforcement pledges. The pauses provide a cool-down period after days that put North America on the cusp of a trade war.
n446f784a0b.why: Mexico and Canada are the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariff threats on them affect North American supply chains, currencies and cross-border equities.
n446f784a0b.why_moved: The tariff pause reduces the immediate threat of a North American trade war, which had been weighing on currencies and trade-exposed assets.

na79bc355dc.headline: Oil prices dip as tariffs take effect
na79bc355dc.summary: U.S. crude fell nearly 2% on Tuesday as tariffs on China took effect. President Trump paused for a month a decision on steep levies on Canada and Mexico, and WTI declined $1.32 a barrel.
na79bc355dc.why: WTI is the main U.S. crude benchmark, and trade tariffs affect global demand expectations for oil.
na79bc355dc.why_moved: Tariffs on Chinese imports taking effect raised concerns about weaker trade and oil demand, while the pause on levies for Canada and Mexico eased some supply-chain worries.

n9e4d138828.headline: China counters US tariffs with new trade measures and Google probe
n9e4d138828.summary: China imposed tariffs on multiple US imports in response to President Donald Trump's tariffs. It also announced an antitrust investigation into Google and other trade measures.
n9e4d138828.why: China is one of the world's largest trading economies, and tariff disputes with the United States affect global supply chains and corporate earnings. Alphabet is the parent of Google, a major US technology company.
n9e4d138828.why_moved: China responded to US tariffs with its own tariffs on multiple US imports and announced an antitrust probe into Google, escalating trade tensions.

n5055ad918a.headline: Sensex, Nifty: Stock market cheered Trump tariff pause but Nomura has a warning; 4 scenarios - BusinessToday
n5055ad918a.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 1.74% to 78,527.36 and the Nifty gained 1.63% to 23,740.95 on Tuesday. Nomura revised upward its base case for US tariffs.
n5055ad918a.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark equity indexes of India's stock market. Their moves reflect investor sentiment toward domestic and global trade conditions.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Investors reacted positively to the tariff pause, lifting the benchmark index.

n26cf03fdb4.headline: The Trade War Comes For Temu
n26cf03fdb4.summary: Americans flocked to Temu and Shein for low-priced goods. The article argues that Trump's tariffs could destroy these online retailers' US business.
n26cf03fdb4.why: PDD Holdings owns Temu, a low-price e-commerce platform that depends heavily on imports into the United States. Tariffs on imported goods directly affect its cost structure.

nde4e152b7b.headline: TSX futures fall as crude prices dip on US-China trade conflict
nde4e152b7b.summary: Futures for Canada's main stock index declined as oil prices fell after an escalating trade war between the U.S. and China, overshadowing Ottawa's temporary relief from US tariffs.
nde4e152b7b.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and it is heavily weighted toward energy and materials.
nde4e152b7b.why_moved: Oil prices fell after an escalating US-China trade war, and the TSX futures followed lower.

nbe5341bda7.headline: ONEOK Announces Joint Ventures with MPLX to Build LPG Export Terminal at Premier Location on U.S. Gulf Coast
nbe5341bda7.summary: ONEOK and MPLX have entered definitive agreements to form joint ventures to build a new LPG export terminal on the US Gulf Coast. The project expands their integrated NGL value chain.
nbe5341bda7.why: ONEOK is a midstream energy company handling natural gas liquids, and LPG export capacity links US producers to overseas buyers.

n47eefcefe1.headline: LARRY KUDLOW: We can't let China slip away
n47eefcefe1.summary: President Trump has slapped 10% tariffs on China, according to a Fox Business commentary that says the move is aimed at ending the fentanyl epidemic in America.
n47eefcefe1.why: US tariffs on Chinese imports raise costs for importers and can prompt retaliation, affecting trade flows between the two largest economies.
n47eefcefe1.why_moved: New 10% US tariffs on Chinese goods raise import costs and raise the risk of trade retaliation between the two countries.

n2fbdaf04d6.headline: China imposes new tariffs on U.S. goods in retaliation
n2fbdaf04d6.summary: China announced on Tuesday that it will impose new tariffs on US imports in retaliation for Washington's recent tariff increase.
n2fbdaf04d6.why: Tariff retaliation between the world's two largest economies disrupts trade flows, affecting exporters, supply chains and global equity and currency markets.
n2fbdaf04d6.why_moved: China's retaliatory tariffs on US imports follow a recent US tariff hike, raising trade costs and escalating the dispute.

nfe2cf73057.headline: Insolvencies rose 12.1 per cent in 2024, led by business filings
nfe2cf73057.summary: Insolvencies rose 12.1% last year compared with 2023, with business insolvencies up 28.6%, according to the report from Ottawa.
nfe2cf73057.why: Insolvency trends are a read on corporate financial stress and credit conditions in the broader economy.

n4252a69437.headline: China launches an antitrust probe into Google. Here's what it means
n4252a69437.summary: The Chinese government has opened an antitrust probe into Google. The move is the latest development in a long and entangled relationship dating back to the early 2000s.
n4252a69437.why: Alphabet's Google is a global technology company whose business in China is limited, but regulatory actions by Beijing affect how investors view US tech firms' exposure to China.

ne796697a94.headline: This budget hatch toppled Tesla to become Europe's best-selling model
ne796697a94.summary: The Dacia Sandero was Europe's best-selling new car, according to the input. It overtook the Tesla Model Y, which had previously held the top position.
ne796697a94.why: Dacia is a Romanian budget brand owned by Renault Group, and shifts in European car sales affect automakers' market share and EV competition.

n7214d86345.headline: Principal owner Industrivärden buys shares in SCA for SEK 305 million (translation)
n7214d86345.summary: Investment company Industrivärden bought 2.0 million Class B shares in forest products firm SCA on February 3. The shares were acquired at an average price of SEK 152.69.
n7214d86345.why: Industrivärden is a major Swedish investment company and principal owner of SCA, so its share purchases signal shifts in its stake.

nd4625d5636.headline: China targets Google, other US firms as trade tensions escalate
nd4625d5636.summary: China has slapped retaliatory tariffs on US firms including Google as trade tensions escalate. The tariffs are set to take effect on February 10.
nd4625d5636.why: Alphabet, Google's parent, is a major US technology company whose overseas revenue depends on market access. Retaliatory tariffs raise costs and increase trade-war risk for exporters.
nd4625d5636.why_moved: Chinese retaliatory tariffs aimed at US technology firms raise trade tensions, which typically weigh on exposed US tech shares.

n10e7a96c2e.headline: Taskforce recommends splitting ‘inefficient’ Biman Bangladesh in two
n10e7a96c2e.summary: A taskforce recommends splitting Biman Bangladesh into two entities because it is inefficient. An adviser questioned why Biman is in such distress when other Bangladeshi airlines are profitable.
n10e7a96c2e.why: Biman is Bangladesh's state-owned national carrier, and restructuring decisions affect public finances and the country's aviation market.

nfbae772a1e.headline: Food security minister vows reforms as lint output plunges 34pc
nfbae772a1e.summary: Cotton lint output in Pakistan has plunged 34 per cent. The food security minister said the ministry remains committed to enhancing cotton production and supporting farmers.
nfbae772a1e.why: Cotton is a key raw material for Pakistan's textile sector, which is its largest export industry. Shortfalls in output raise import needs and costs for textile producers.

impacts.name: Cotton
impacts.why: A 34% fall in Pakistani lint output reduces domestic cotton supply for textile mills.

n2ab4c5fde6.headline: Trade gap hits $2.3b as imports stay high
n2ab4c5fde6.summary: Pakistan's trade gap reached $2.3 billion as imports remained above $5 billion for a second straight month. Exports also showed healthy growth.
n2ab4c5fde6.why: The trade balance shows how much a country imports relative to exports, and wide gaps put pressure on the currency and foreign reserves. Pakistan's external position is closely watched by international lenders.

ne2f9e6eb68.headline: Trump's tariff threat has hit a nerve with Canadians
ne2f9e6eb68.summary: A trade war with the U.S. has been averted for now, but Canada is roiled by Trump's remarks, and the threat of tariffs still remains. The situation is weighing on Canadian sentiment.
ne2f9e6eb68.why: Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, and tariffs directly affect its exports of energy, metals and manufactured goods. Trade policy is a key driver of Canadian growth outlooks.

ndeb69ce838.headline: US tariffs could affect Cyprus through broader economic slowdown, warns expert
ndeb69ce838.summary: Despite Cyprus's relatively modest trade volume with the US, the island could experience indirect effects of US tariffs on European goods. Sofronis Clerides, a University of Cyprus economist, made the warning.
ndeb69ce838.why: Cyprus is a small open economy with significant services and shipping ties, so changes in European demand from trade frictions can transmit to its growth.

n231e0a5ee4.headline: China counters with tariffs on US products and says it will investigate Google
n231e0a5ee4.summary: China announced tariffs on US products and launched an investigation into Google, escalating trade tensions.
n231e0a5ee4.why: Trade disputes and tariffs influence global supply chains and market sentiment, especially between US and China.

n064b0ad6bd.headline: PM Shehbaz hails overseas Pakistanis over 30% increase in remittances
n064b0ad6bd.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz praised a 30% increase in remittances from overseas Pakistanis, benefiting the national exchequer.
n064b0ad6bd.why: Remittances are vital for Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves and balance of payments.

nda2e27b839.headline: Why are Rio Tinto
nda2e27b839.summary: Two tropical cyclones near Western Australia have affected Rio Tinto's operations.
nda2e27b839.why: Weather events can disrupt mining activities, affecting commodity supply and prices.
